title: Canara Rupay Platinum Secured credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The Canara RuPay Platinum Secured credit card from Canara Bank is a fixed-deposit–backed secured card that helps users build or strengthen their credit profile while offering RuPay network acceptance and basic reward and transaction benefits for everyday spending.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
